headline: PM honours four Hafez for success in Saudi Quran competition
summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman hosted a reception for Bangladeshi winners of the 46th King Abdul Aziz International Holy Quran Competition.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman honoured four Bangladeshi Hafez who won prizes at the 46th King Abdul Aziz International Holy Quran Competition in Saudi Arabia this August.
During a reception at the Secretariat, the PM stated that their achievement is a victory for all Muslims in Bangladesh and emphasized the government's policy to recognize talented children.
Mohammad Zakaria secured first place in the 15 Para Hifz, Tajweed and beautiful recitation category, competing against participants from 133 countries.
Sheikh Mohammad Mahmudul Hasan Ashrafi, Hafeza Rabeta Binte Ramzan, and Hafeza Musfira Binte Mahmud each secured third place in their respective categories.
The Prime Minister listened to Quran recitations from the winners and handed over books as tokens of appreciation.
The PM also assured government support for future international competitions and urged organizers to follow proper channels for assistance.
Religious Affairs Minister Kazi Shah Mofazzal Hossain Kaikobad and other high-ranking officials, along with the winners' teachers, were present at the event.
caption:
Four Bangladeshi Hafez have brought glory to the nation by winning prizes at a prestigious international Quran competition in Saudi Arabia.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman honoured four Bangladeshi Hafez who won prizes at the 46th King Abdul Aziz International Holy Quran Competition in Saudi Arabia this August.

During a reception at the Secretariat, the PM stated that their achievement is a victory for all Muslims in Bangladesh and emphasized the government's policy to recognize talented children.

Mohammad Zakaria secured first place in the 15 Para Hifz, Tajweed and beautiful recitation category, competing against participants from 133 countries.

Sheikh Mohammad Mahmudul Hasan Ashrafi, Hafeza Rabeta Binte Ramzan, and Hafeza Musfira Binte Mahmud each secured third place in their respective categories.

The Prime Minister listened to Quran recitations from the winners and handed over books as tokens of appreciation.

The PM also assured government support for future international competitions and urged organizers to follow proper channels for assistance.

Religious Affairs Minister Kazi Shah Mofazzal Hossain Kaikobad and other high-ranking officials, along with the winners' teachers, were present at the event.

Source: The Daily Star, Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV

headline_marked: Major reshuffle: [[Kamrul Ahsan appointed SB chief]] as 6 top police officers shifted
headline: Major reshuffle: Kamrul Ahsan appointed SB chief as 6 top police officers shifted
summary: The Ministry of Home Affairs has ordered a major reshuffle and promotions in the top ranks of the Bangladesh Police, including the appointment of a new Special Branch chief.
details: The Ministry of Home Affairs issued a notification on Thursday detailing a major reshuffle and promotions among top police officials. The orders were issued by the President's order and signed by Toucif Ahmed, Deputy Secretary of the Police-1 branch of the Public Security Division.
caption:
A major shake-up in the top police ranks! Kamrul Ahsan takes over as the Special Branch chief.

The Ministry of Home Affairs issued a notification on Thursday detailing a major reshuffle and promotions among top police officials. The orders were issued by the President's order and signed by Toucif Ahmed, Deputy Secretary of the Police-1 branch of the Public Security Division.

#Bangladesh #Police #Reshuffle #HomeMinistry #LawEnforcement

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Prothom Alo, Jamuna TV
